title: Design a professional DappGo product and app directory
question: Can visitors understand DappGo products and reach the correct web or store destination with clear platform availability?
hypotheses: A product-first directory with explicit platform links will reduce navigation ambiguity compared with contact-only product cards.
acceptance_criteria: Deliver a local responsive interactive design and written UI and technical specifications.
Include the four requested web destinations, four verified Android listings and two requested iOS listings.
Verify Chinese and English, light and dark themes, mobile layout and keyboard interactions.
Keep canonical homepage, advertising settings and production unchanged.
evidence: Owner requested a new worktree and UI/technical design before implementation or deployment.
